item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-29
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen significant progress across multiple projects. Notably, the `MicheleNuijten/statcheck` and `giladfeldman/escicheck` projects have made administrative updates and synchronizations, respectively, to enhance their functionality. Meanwhile, `quest-bih/oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator's code validation, and `giladfeldman/docpluck` has addressed various issues, including text loss and rendering fixes. The `Davidvandijcke/coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker, and `JamieCummins/regcheck` has resolved several bugs and updated its demo page. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to improving and refining our research tools, and we celebrate the connections and collaborations that make these advancements possible.
